svg.aria-label: Multiplying in scientific notation: multiply the coefficients and add the exponents of 10. 5 times 10 cubed times 4 times 10 squared gives 20 times 10 to the 5. Because 20 is 10 or more, move a power of 10 into the exponent: 2 times 10 to the 6.
